# launch_sunshine

[← Command index](README.md)

Start the Sunshine game-streaming host installed by setup_tools.

## Synopsis

```
launch_sunshine [options]
```

## Description

Runs the Sunshine program from the tools directory so a Moonlight client can stream
games from this machine. It waits for Sunshine to exit and logs an error if it exits
with a non-zero code. It takes only the common options.

## Options

### Common options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-v, --verbose` | Enable verbose mode. |
| `-p, --pretend_run` | Do a pretend run with no permanent changes. |
| `-x, --exit_on_failure` | Enable exit on failure mode. |
| `--no-preview` | Skip the preview confirmation prompt. |

## Examples

### Start Sunshine

```bash
launch_sunshine
```

### Dry run without starting Sunshine

```bash
launch_sunshine -p -v
```

## Notes

- Sunshine must be installed first (`setup_tools -k Sunshine`); the command exits with an error if it is not found.
